consequence.statement: More query types (stats, volume, label, series) are cached by default into the results_cache, which is in-memory by default; the service still works but with different caching behavior.

assertion.statement: Results caching for TSDB 'stats' and 'volume' queries, plus 'label' and 'series' requests, is now enabled by default, using the results_cache in the query_range config (in-memory by default).
